title: Rented By The Owner

headline: Rented straight from the owner. Nobody in the middle.
subhead: A unit in a 507-home community on the South Florida coast, offered directly — and backed by a resident board of neighbours who already do the things a building usually charges you for.

items.caption: The living room, looking through to the kitchen

sections.heading: Why this one is different
items: Most rentals hand you keys and a phone number for a management company two towns away. This one hands you a building that already works.

There is a resident board here — neighbours who watch packages, walk dogs, sit with someone who shouldn't be alone all day, and fix the thing that broke on a Sunday. Not a vendor list. People who live upstairs.
The owner manages this unit through I.Magin Concierge, which means one number for the lease, the repairs, and the move-in — and a written punch list instead of a promise.

items.name: Mail & package watch
items.note: Deliveries kept out of the open hallway while you're at work or in the air.

items.name: Dog walking & pet sitting
items.note: Your animal stays home instead of boarding. The person holding the leash lives one elevator ride away.

items.name: Senior companion & care
items.note: Company, errands and appointments, for a household that needs it.

items.name: Moving, staging & logistics
items.note: Move-in day handled by someone who already knows the loading dock and the elevator rules.

sections.heading: Ask about it
sections.title: One question is enough to start.
sections.note: No application, no fee, no form that sells your details onward. Ask what you actually want to know and you get a straight answer from the owner.

footer_notes: This page is published by the owner. It is not a brokerage listing, and no commission is being collected by anyone for showing it to you.
